exEn: The building requires regular maintenance to keep it in good condition.

exEn: Doing the dishes is my least favorite household chore.
exUa: Миття посуду — мій найменш улюблений хатній обов'язок.

exEn: We plan to renovate the kitchen before the end of the year.

exEn: The company’s annual revenue increased by fifteen percent.

exEn: The logistics team is organizing the inventory inside the warehouse.

exEn: Effective distribution channels are essential for international trade.
